patterns.note: The site uses a full-bleed video hero with overlaid product imagery and text, transitioning to a dark, content-focused layout with asymmetrical product grids.
A highly distinctive, thin, serif display font is used for primary headings, creating an elegant and editorial feel, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text and navigation.
Large, pixelated, uppercase sans-serif text is employed as a dominant visual element for section titles like 'STUDIOS' and 'SIGN UP', giving a retro-digital aesthetic.
A predominantly dark theme (black and dark grey backgrounds) with high-contrast white or light text is used, punctuated by vibrant, often glowing, product photography.

Upon initial scroll, the hero section's foreground elements (product image, main heading, CTA button) scale down and translate upwards, while the background video exhibits a subtle parallax effect. Simultaneously, the transparent navigation bar transitions to a sticky header with a solid black background.
Product showcase sections feature a two-column grid where one product image is often larger or more prominent, accompanied by a product name and 'Shop Now' link.

technique_notes: The hero section combines a full-bleed video background with overlaid content. As the user scrolls, the foreground elements (product, main heading, CTA) scale down and move up, while the background video moves at a slower rate to create a parallax effect. The navigation bar simultaneously transitions from transparent to a fixed, solid-background header.
Large, impactful section titles are rendered using a pixelated, uppercase typeface, achieved through custom font rendering or image-based text, creating a unique retro-digital visual identity.
Content sections are introduced with subtle reveal animations, such as a fade-in or slide-up, as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's attention.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, thin serif hero heading (~4-5x body) with smaller, clean sans-serif subheadings and body text. Large pixelated section titles are extremely dominant (~6-8x body).
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, especially in the hero and large typographic sections, creating a sense of spaciousness and focus. Product grids are more balanced.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its unique blend of a cosmic, dark aesthetic with a highly refined, thin serif display font and bold, pixelated section titles. The pixelated typography, in particular, gives the site a unique, retro-futuristic character that sets it apart from typical modern marketing sites.
